title: Make Main a Delivery-Only Branch
intent: Ensure that the base branch changes only when an accepted Work delivers product content
motivation: An open Work already has an authoritative manifest ref. Projecting the manifest into main when a stage starts creates another representation of the same state and causes unnecessary commits, index reconciliation, branch contamination, and integration complexity. Explicit non-goals: no large-scale WorkService decomposition, no removal of legacy read compatibility, no redesign of the lifecycle, no database or external state store.
ordering: The contract first, because every later change is judged against it. Then the branch cut, the removal of mutable manifest state from Change branches, and the integration split — accept-only delivery and non-accepted outcomes staying off the base are siblings on that foundation. Compatibility follows so old repositories keep reading, and the invariant tests cap the Initiative by converting characterization into enforcement.
